name: system-decomposition
description: C4 Level 2 (containers) and Level 3 (components) system decomposition. Per container: name, purpose, technology, responsibilities, APIs exposed, data stores. Per component: role within container, collaborators. Relationships between containers and components with protocol + purpose. Distinct from context-diagramming (C4 L1) and code-level diagrams (L4). Mermaid diagrams with optional PNG export.
